MEASURED AT 400 ON /layouts/browse/ui-card/: the Approve/Improve row was at y=1,043 and is now at y=153 - 890px higher, from a screen and a third of scrolling to the first screen. The order below 40rem is heading, verdict box, the 400 picture, then a fold reading 'The other widths - 1920 and 3440 pixels'. Same numbers on layout-1-flow (1,043 to 153); approved-rail-content, which has only one picture and so no fold, went 157 to 210 because the box above it is now real estate rather than a line.

40rem AND ABOVE IS UNCHANGED IN ORDER, re-shot on three items at 1280/1920/3440: heading, the three-width row, the trail and the one line, the verdict box, the way out, the folds - the order shipped earlier today, all three pictures in one row, no fold element in the DOM. The verdict row's y moved 798 to 774 at 1920 and 946 to 919 at 3440 because the body is now three page-grid boxes instead of one nested .flow, so the rhythm between them is the page's --flow rather than the inner box's; nothing reordered and nothing resized.

HOW IT IS DONE - four boxes instead of two, all direct children of the page grid (pictures, lede, seat, rest), and browse.css gives the other three order:1 below 39.99rem. NOT order:-1 on the seat: the h1 is a child of the same grid with the default order of 0, so a negative order put the verdict ABOVE the page's own heading (seat y=49, heading y=147). Pushing the other three to 1 leaves the seat tied with the heading and a tie breaks on DOM order, so the heading keeps its place.

TWO RHYTHM RULES LAND ON THE WRONG BOX WHEN order MOVES THINGS - framework.css's `.page-title + *` (1.5x --flow) and `.flow > * + *` both follow DOM order, so the heading rhythm went to the pictures (DOM child one, drawn third) and the box now under the heading got none. Each box takes the rhythm of the position it is actually drawn in; that is a general trap for any `order` in this framework, not just this page.

RE-PRESSED after the split: Approve and Improve still append for real and still update a second tab's mark and tier count with no reload; the fold opens to all three pictures and does NOT move the buttons (they sit above it); resizing across 40rem in both directions re-renders the right arrangement (a matchMedia listener that drops itself once its box leaves the document, the same discipline live() follows); no console error at any width; verdicts.jsonl back to 0 bytes.
